summary: Excellent, comprehensive UI interaction specification. The document covers 15 major interaction categories including click behaviors, keyboard shortcuts, slider mechanics, list navigation, context menus, drag-and-drop, focus states, modals, touch controls, animations, accessibility, and error handling. All 4 JSON data blocks are valid and parseable. No placeholder text (TODO/TBD) found. Hotkey mappings are internally consistent with UI_OVERVIEW.md. The document successfully adapts MOO1 interaction patterns for modern web while adding tablet touch support and full accessibility features. Implementation-ready with detailed timing constants, animation specs, and ARIA attributes. Strong attention to edge cases and error handling.
